options_considered.label: Dedicated F04 cleanup sprint
options_considered.description: Create a dedicated feature (F04) to address all accumulated tech debt, lint errors, missing tests, stale docs, and missing tooling before building any new functionality.
pros: Clean slate before scaling to all sets
All debt resolved in one pass with clear acceptance criteria
cons: Cleanup features are hard to scope — risk of scope creep
Some items are trivial and don't warrant a full feature ceremony

options_considered.label: Fix incrementally as part of next feature (Wave 0 hygiene)
options_considered.description: Address critical debt items as Wave 0 tasks in the next feature. Non-critical items are tracked in a backlog and fixed opportunistically.
pros: Debt is fixed in context where it matters
Smaller, focused changes are easier to review
cons: Risk of perpetually deferring non-critical items
Wave 0 gets bloated if too many items are front-loaded
Some items (like stale docs) affect multiple files and don't fit cleanly into a feature

recommendation: B — Fix incrementally. The debt is manageable (no blockers, no security issues). Front-load critical items in the next feature's Wave 0, track the rest in a lightweight backlog.

technical_debt.title: 10 ruff lint errors from F01 code
technical_debt.description: 9 unused imports + 1 line-length violation in src/parsers/myp.py and src/providers/myp/provider.py. Identified in F02 QA report, still unresolved.
technical_debt.remediation: Run `ruff check --fix` for auto-fixable issues, manually fix the rest. Add pre-commit hook or CI gate.

technical_debt.title: Inline timedelta imports in indicators.py
technical_debt.description: Lines 117 and 171 import `from datetime import timedelta` inside function bodies instead of at module top. PEP 8 violation, inconsistent with codebase.
technical_debt.remediation: Move import to top of file alongside existing `from datetime import date, datetime`.

technical_debt.title: Unusual SQLAlchemy pattern in get_observation_count
technical_debt.description: repository.py:221 uses `select(text("count(*)"))` which is an unconventional SQLAlchemy pattern. Should use `func.count()` for consistency with get_cards_with_observations.

technical_debt.title: Population vs sample std dev undocumented
technical_debt.description: compute_volatility uses population std dev (/ n). This is defensible but not documented in the docstring. TechLead flagged this.
technical_debt.remediation: Add one-line note to docstring explaining the choice and rationale.

technical_debt.title: No pre-commit hooks or CI lint gate
technical_debt.description: Lint errors from F01 survived through F02 and F03 because there is no automated enforcement. `make lint` exists but is not mandatory.
technical_debt.remediation: Add pre-commit config with ruff check + ruff format, or add a CI workflow that runs lint on push.

technical_debt.title: Hardcoded source='myp' throughout backfill.py
technical_debt.description: backfill.py hardcodes 'myp' as the source string in error creation and retry logic instead of using provider.source_name. Will need refactoring when adding second provider.
technical_debt.remediation: Use provider.source_name property instead of string literal.

technical_debt.title: insert_price_observations does SELECT per row for dedup
technical_debt.description: Repository inserts observations one-by-one with a SELECT check for each. For DMR (30 cards) this is fine, but scaling to all sets (~10k+ cards) will be very slow.
technical_debt.remediation: Use SQLAlchemy's `insert().on_conflict_do_nothing()` with a unique index, or batch check with `external_id IN (...)` queries.

test_coverage_gaps.title: No test for past_price == 0 in compute_momentum
test_coverage_gaps.description: The division-by-zero guard at indicators.py:181 returns None but has no explicit test. Flagged by both TechLead and QA.
test_coverage_gaps.remediation: Add a test with a HistoricalPrice series where the past observation has price Decimal('0').

test_coverage_gaps.title: No test for invalid price_field argument
test_coverage_gaps.description: Passing a nonexistent field name degrades gracefully but is not tested. Flagged by both TechLead and QA.
test_coverage_gaps.remediation: Add a test with price_field='nonexistent' verifying None return.

test_coverage_gaps.title: pytest-cov not in dev dependencies
test_coverage_gaps.description: Cannot measure automated branch coverage. QA had to do manual branch audit. Flagged in both F03 QA report and TechLead review.
test_coverage_gaps.remediation: Add pytest-cov to [project.optional-dependencies].dev in pyproject.toml. Add --cov flags to pytest config.

test_coverage_gaps.title: No integration tests for collector/provider
test_coverage_gaps.description: backfill.py, provider.py, and the full collection pipeline have zero tests. The 103 tests cover parsers, repository, analytics, and CLI — but not the orchestration layer or HTTP error handling paths.
test_coverage_gaps.remediation: Add integration tests with mocked HTTP responses for run_backfill, run_update, and run_retry_failed. Test error handling, rate limiting, and dry-run mode.

test_coverage_gaps.title: README test structure section is outdated
test_coverage_gaps.description: README shows only test_parsers.py (27 tests) and test_repository.py under tests/unit/. Missing 4 analytics test files (75 tests).
test_coverage_gaps.remediation: Update the Project Structure section in README.md.

architecture_health.title: Sequential card processing will not scale
architecture_health.description: backfill.py processes cards sequentially with asyncio.sleep between each. For DMR (30 cards) this took ~2 min. For all sets (~10k cards at 1s delay), this would take ~3 hours. No concurrency, no resume capability.
architecture_health.remediation: Add configurable concurrency (asyncio.Semaphore), checkpoint/resume support (skip already-collected cards), and progress reporting.

architecture_health.title: SQLite may bottleneck at scale
architecture_health.description: SQLite is fine for the current 1889 observations. At full scale (~10k cards x ~150 observations = 1.5M rows), write contention and query performance may degrade. Not blocking yet but worth monitoring.
architecture_health.remediation: Monitor query times as data grows. The SQLAlchemy abstraction makes migration to PostgreSQL straightforward if needed.

architecture_health.title: Provider abstraction is well-designed for multi-source
architecture_health.description: CardSourceProvider ABC, separate parsers, and source-tagged data make adding Liga Magic or other sources clean. No action needed.
architecture_health.remediation: None — this is a positive finding.

architecture_health.title: Analytics purity is excellent
architecture_health.description: Zero database imports in src/analytics/. Pure Decimal arithmetic. Easily testable and composable. No action needed.
architecture_health.remediation: None — this is a positive finding.
